intent: Record structured framework frictions, generate deterministic retrospectives, and export privacy-conscious feedback for cross-project analysis.
steps: Record an observation when execution exposes unexpected rework, delay, manual intervention, or governance, context, staffing, permissions, tooling, verification or environment limitations
Capture the observed symptom and evidence; classify origin as unknown until evidence supports a stronger classification
Link observations to Work Unit and evidence or event identifiers when available
Record operational blockers, defects or decision requests separately when the current execution also requires them
Generate a work-unit retrospective by aggregating recorded objects for the specified Work Unit
Generate a project retrospective by aggregating recorded objects for the whole project when requested
Treat retrospective output as a derived snapshot, not an assertion that every underlying observation is correctly classified
Export structured feedback with default privacy-preserving detail level
Require explicit human authorization and data-handling review before full-detail export
invariants: Observations do not replace operational blockers or defects required for current execution
Do not infer framework causation without evidence
Full-detail export requires explicit human authorization
